role: XCTest suite for RRDataImporter parsing: Elite HRV / Emuqu multi-session detection, seconds→ms conversion, JSON/CSV/plain-text parsers including the CSV range-check asymmetries, Elite HRV summary parsing, crafted-timestamp rejection in multi-session exports, validate's one-week span limit, error text, date parsing, createSession and quoted CSV lines.
state: savedDefaultTimeZone: static OSAllocatedUnfairLock<TimeZone?> holding the process time zone during the class
mem:NSTimeZone.default (set to UTC for the class, restored in class tearDown)
toplevel: Class-level setUp/tearDown pin NSTimeZone.default to UTC and restore it; a fresh RRDataImporter is a stored property per test.

units.does: Class setUp: saves NSTimeZone.default into the lock and sets the process default time zone to UTC.
units.entry: XCTest runner: class setUp once before the suite

units.does: Class tearDown: restores the saved NSTimeZone.default if any and clears the saved value.
units.entry: XCTest runner: class tearDown after the suite

branches.effect: restores NSTimeZone.default to it; otherwise leaves the process time zone as UTC
